name: Iota Piscium
description: A naked-eye star 13.7 parsecs away, 1.6 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 222368: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.082 +/- 0.009 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.595 +/- 0.014

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 222368: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.268 +/- 0.009

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 222368: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6288 +/- 37

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 222368: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 72.91 +/- 0.15 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 14 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.6 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.082 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.595 solar radii and 6,288 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 222368: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
